classification.difficultyReason: Identify the clearly visible rise-and-fall pattern and explain directly why a straight line fails to follow it. The prompt already supplies the judgement that the fit is inappropriate; no calculation, construction or linked procedure is required.

inlines.text: Explain why the shown line of best fit would

spec.description: One scatterplot with nine crosses rising and then falling in an arch, with a gently rising proposed straight line.
spec.mathematics: The crosses follow an inverted-U pattern: a non-linear association that a straight line does not represent.
spec.answerVisibility: Axes, crosses and the proposed blue line are permanent student-visible givens; the explanation appears only in the answer.

answer.short: The association is curved, not linear.
answer.worked: The points rise and then fall, showing a non-linear association. A straight line does not follow this pattern.
